one_liner: Yordan Alvarez saw only 750 pitches in 2025 but hit the ball 107.7 mph at the 90th percentile -- eighth-hardest in this pull.
three_things: 107.7 mph at the 90th percentile, from a season a third the length of his peers'.
235 rows with recorded exit velocity is the smallest exit-velocity sample of any hitter profiled here.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (pitches_faced_2025>=300 floor, 485 of 671 batters). Exit-velocity figures use rows with recorded exit velocity. Estimated wOBA on contact uses rows with recorded model estimates, whose count is not reported here, and is a batted-ball model: it says nothing about walks, strikeouts, or actual results. This pull carries no swing/miss or launch-angle column, so there is no whiff rate and no barrel profile here. Not park-, role-, or opponent-adjusted, and not a prediction. League-wide ranks were computed by sorting all 485 batters in this manifest on the named field; every printed value is read verbatim. With 235 rows with recorded exit velocity the exit-velocity figures carry wide uncertainty; treat the rank as a description of this season's sample, not a durable rating.
